final_answer:
Microsoft’s gross margin improved from fiscal year 2023 to fiscal year 2024.

From the FY2024 10-K:  
- FY2024 revenue: $245,122M; cost of revenue: $74,114M [DOC: msft_margin.txt]  
- FY2023 revenue (comparative): $211,915M; cost of revenue: $65,863M [DOC: msft_margin.txt]  

Using these figures (same company, same fiscal year basis, directly comparable periods), gross margin percentages are:

- FY2024 gross margin = (245,122 − 74,114) / 245,122 ≈ 69.76% [DOC: msft_margin.txt]  
- FY2023 gross margin = (211,915 − 65,863) / 211,915 ≈ 68.92% [DOC: msft_margin.txt]  

Change = 69.76% − 68.92% ≈ +0.84 percentage points.

ANSWER: Microsoft’s gross margin improved by approximately 0.8 percentage points from FY2023 to FY2024.
